note: What a server sends about a lasting effect in a slot that already holds one. The header names the unit carrying the effect, which can differ from the caster named inside.

fields.name: slot
fields.note: Which of the unit's effect slots. A client fails where it is above 31.

fields.name: lasts
fields.note: How long it runs from now, in seconds. A client applies a value below zero as given.

fields.name: caster
fields.note: The unit that put it there. Where the client holds no such unit, it leaves the effect with no caster.

revisions.note: It carries no effect number: a client re-times the effect already in the slot and takes caster as its caster again. Where the slot is empty, nothing happens.
